issue_title: Integrate NIXL EP with NIXL CPU Proxy

qa_init_calibration.COST: High — maximum quality; strongest model/review budget
qa_init_calibration.DOCS_SET: High-docs — full docs; architecture split into HLD + LLD
qa_init_calibration.GOV1: Interactive [experimental] — we discuss each artifact together (mid-panel must_ask elicitation) before proceeding
qa_init_calibration.RUN_UI: With UI — open/reuse the local Run UI for progress and debug visibility
qa_init_calibration.SUBAGENT_APPROVAL: Yes - allow relay-local sub-agents for pipeline jobs

qa_brainstorm.F1: Integrate the NIXL EP example with the NIXL CPU Proxy GPU device backend for a correctness-first Phase 1. The initial target is EP running through CPU proxy with 1 proxy worker and N proxy channels, where N covers EP's logical lanes; performance scaling is deferred.
qa_brainstorm.F2: Phase 1 should mainly impact examples/device/ep/meson.build, examples/device/ep/csrc/nixl_ep.cpp, and a new proxy context publish wrapper under examples/device/ep/csrc/kernels/. It should consume existing proxy APIs in src/api/gpu/proxy/, src/core/device_proxy/, and src/plugins/ucx/device_proxy/ without changing CPU proxy internals. Phase 1.5 can then address internal CPU proxy infrastructure for multiple workers/channels and channel-to-backend-worker mapping.
qa_brainstorm.F3: No new third-party dependency is expected for Phase 1. The integration depends on existing CUDA device linking, the NIXL GPU Device API proxy backend, the UCX backend/provider, and EP's CUDA/UCX test environment. Validation should use separate UCX-direct and proxy builds, with correctness as the Phase 1 gate.
qa_brainstorm.F4: Reference ep-integ-plan.md, but treat it as a staged plan: Phase 1 is correctness-only EP-on-proxy with proxyWorkerCount=1 and proxyChannelCount=N; Phase 1.5 is CPU proxy infrastructure improvement for multiple workers/channels; Phase 2 is optional nixlGetPtr/NVLink P2P restoration after correctness and baseline behavior are understood.

issues.title: Phase 1 acceptance boundary
issues.decision: Phase 1 is accepted on EP-on-proxy correctness only; performance comparison is a separate follow-on step.

issues.title: Validation topology
issues.decision: Single-node multi-process validation is the initial Phase 1 completion target; two-node proxy RDMA validation follows later.

issues.title: Deferred proxy and LL work
issues.decision: Multi-worker proxy scaling is Phase 1.5, and proxy nixlGetPtr/NVLink P2P restoration is Phase 2.

issues.title: Remaining validation evidence detail
issues.decision: Later stages must define concrete evidence that the proxy path and elastic LL all-RDMA fallback were exercised.

open_topics: Define exact evidence for proxy all-RDMA fallback in elastic LL.
Define acceptable reduced-size EP validation configs if one-worker proxy mode times out at default sizes.
Verify the channel-count formula for HT and LL against current kernel channel-id usage.

issues.title: HT Phase 1 evidence path
issues.decision: An explicitly added HT-compatible proxy smoke can satisfy initial Phase 1 HT acceptance; two-node RDMA validation is follow-on.

issues.title: Elastic LL fallback evidence
issues.decision: LL fallback evidence should combine proxy backend selection, proxy worker activity during LL, and an explicit all-RDMA fallback branch log/counter.

issues.title: Reduced-size timeout criteria
issues.decision: The user skipped this question; later architecture/tasks must define minimum reduced configurations before relying on reduced-size runs.

issues.title: UCX-direct stability evidence
issues.decision: UCX-direct stability is proven by a small smoke/regression only, separate from any UCX-vs-proxy comparison.

issues.title: Phase 1 actors
issues.decision: Phase 1 use cases are manual maintainer actions only; CI/scheduler is not a v1 actor.

open_topics: Define minimum reduced-size EP configurations that still prove proxy correctness if one-worker default runs time out.
Define the exact LL fallback log/counter implementation surface.
Define the exact HT-compatible proxy smoke path.

issues.title: Phase 1 HLD placement
issues.decision: Keep Phase 1 inside the existing EP rank process and NIXL agent-owned CPU proxy runtime; do not add a daemon, service, scheduler, runtime backend selector, or public Python workflow change.

issues.title: Proxy worker and channel boundary
issues.decision: Use one proxy worker with N proxy channels, where N covers EP logical lanes; leave CPU proxy multi-worker/channel-to-worker scaling for Phase 1.5.

issues.title: HT acceptance evidence
issues.decision: Phase 1 may accept a new explicit HT-compatible proxy smoke as the initial acceptance path; real two-node HT RDMA remains follow-on evidence.

issues.title: Elastic LL fallback evidence
issues.decision: LL all-RDMA fallback evidence must be both EP-visible and proxy-runtime-visible; correctness without both evidence classes is inconclusive.

issues.title: Invalid setup versus inconclusive evidence
issues.decision: Missing proxy setup/context, unsupported topology, and under-provisioned channels should hard-fail early; passing runs missing required evidence should be classified as inconclusive.

issues.title: Remaining HLD detail for downstream docs
issues.decision: LLD/tasks must define the exact HT smoke shape, reduced-size correctness floor, instrumentation surfaces, and Phase 2 peer-pointer safety boundaries.

open_topics: Define exact HT-compatible proxy smoke location and command shape.
Define minimum reduced-size HT/LL configurations before relying on reduced-size evidence.
Define concrete instrumentation surfaces for backend selection, proxy activity, channel coverage, and LL fallback signal.
Define Phase 2 peer-pointer safety boundaries before any proxy nixlGetPtr contract changes.

issues.title: Proxy channel sizing contract
issues.decision: Derive cfg.proxyChannelCount from the allocation-time lane ceiling passed through update_memory_buffers(...); allow NIXL_EP_PROXY_CHANNELS as a proxy-only override that must be greater than or equal to required_proxy_channels.

issues.title: Proxy publish and clear seam
issues.decision: Add proxy-mode CUDA wrappers for nixlProxyPublishContext and nixlProxyClearContext, called from the existing Buffer lifecycle after backend creation and before teardown.

issues.title: Phase 1 runtime scope
issues.decision: Use one proxy worker with N proxy channels, keep UCX num_workers=1, and defer channel-to-worker routing, UCX worker/QP scaling, and multi-worker validation to Phase 1.5.

issues.title: HT-compatible proxy smoke
issues.decision: Add a small dedicated HT proxy smoke under examples/device/ep/tests/, separate from the full two-node test_ht.py path.

issues.title: Proxy evidence surface
issues.decision: Require structured ep_proxy_evidence_v1 output from EP validation, backed by lightweight runtime counters or deterministic logs for backend selection, proxy activity, and LL all-RDMA fallback.

issues.title: Invalid or incomplete evidence classification
issues.decision: Fail early on invalid setup such as missing proxy context or under-provisioned channels; classify passing runs with missing proxy/fallback evidence as inconclusive.

open_topics: Define the reduced-size validation floor before any downsized timeout-avoidance run can count as correctness evidence.

issues.title: Phase 1 HT validation path
issues.decision: Accept a dedicated single-node/multiprocess HT-compatible proxy smoke as the Phase 1 HT correctness artifact; defer real two-node RDMA validation to a later validation or performance artifact.

open_topics: Exact HT smoke command/name to be pinned during implementation.
Exact placement of ep_proxy_evidence_v1 helper to follow local code constraints, defaulting to the EP validation/test surface.
Exact proxy activity reset/snapshot seam to be the smallest validation-visible surface that proves supported proxy submissions.
